answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared escrow before it can trade: the stake is ferrous, heavy, hard to fake, and costly to split across many fake identities. Each identity must also earn reputation through a pearl-like chain of verified completed jobs, where each successful trade deposits one iridescent layer of trust. The fable of cheap free accounts collapses because a sybil attacker must pay the full stake per identity and wait out the slow reputation build, while honest agents reuse one stake and one history.
